response_text:
The message from the facilities team is a reminder that the HVAC units on building B, floor 3, will be offline on Saturday, October 17, from 6am to 2pm for maintenance. As a result, the west wing will lose cooling, but the east wing will remain unaffected. The team has requested that if the lab freezers on that floor are affected, samples should be moved to the floor 2 units by Friday, October 16, end of day.

This message needs action from you if you are responsible for the lab freezers on floor 3 or if you have samples that need to be moved to a different location. You should verify if the freezers will be affected by the HVAC maintenance and make arrangements to move the samples to floor 2 if necessary.
